prompts.title: Watercolor Family Portrait
prompts.prompt:
Convert the reference family into a heartwarming mixed-media family portrait in a vertical 4:5 aspect ratio, blending photorealistic facial detail with elegant watercolor painting on textured off-white watercolor paper.
The portrait is captured at eye level with a slightly close-up perspective, showing a loving family of three in a close, intimate embrace. The child is centered between both parents, held securely and comfortably, smiling with joyful, open-mouthed laughter. The child wears light blue pajamas with small cartoon panda patterns.
The mother stands on the left, wearing a soft light-blue button-down shirt, with a gentle affectionate smile. The father stands on the right, wearing a dark black shirt and a golden wristwatch, smiling naturally with warmth and happiness. Both parents stay close to the child, with their heads gently near each other, creating a soft family-centered composition. Their arms naturally wrap around the child, showing love, protection, and emotional connection.
Render the faces, eyes, skin texture, hair, and clothing folds with high-definition realism. Keep the facial details photorealistic, while the outer edges of the figures softly dissolve into expressive watercolor washes, ink splashes, paint drips, and painterly brush textures.
Use muted earthy watercolor tones such as deep navy blue, soft slate blue, warm sepia brown, beige, and subtle olive green. The watercolor textures should bloom outward behind the family, creating an elegant artistic halo effect.
The background should be clean textured off-white watercolor paper with visible paper grain. Add delicate hand-drawn decorative details, including small sketch-style heart doodles and a subtle botanical leaf branch in the upper-right area. In the upper-left corner, add elegant handwritten calligraphy text: “Together is our favorite place to be.”
Lighting should be soft, diffused, and natural, with no harsh shadows. Maintain a warm, emotional, sentimental mood suitable for a premium family keepsake illustration or greeting card artwork.
Style: photorealistic watercolor portrait, mixed-media illustration, realistic faces, painterly edges, watercolor splash art, textured paper canvas, emotional family portrait, soft natural lighting, premium fine-art keepsake, high-detail digital painting.

prompts.title: Dreamy Birthday Bliss
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image as an reference for the girl’s face, hair & identity.  Do not alter facial features.
A full-body portrait of a reference cute girl standing beside a birthday cake at a themed party, centered in a soft, dreamy indoor studio setting.
The theme is fully inspired by Hello Kitty, with a color palette of soft pink, white, and red, with subtle pastel accents.
The child has a sweet smile, and hair styled in an elegant updo with soft curls framing her face.
She is wearing a luxurious, sparkling dress in white and soft pink tones, with delicate lace details, glitter textures, and Hello Kitty character patterns printed across the fabric.
The dress features a semi-transparent lace neckline and sleeves, with a flared skirt decorated with bows, hearts, and subtle shimmering particles.
She also wears a decorative headband featuring Hello Kitty ears with a signature red bow and a small elegant tiara detail.
On her feet are white lace knee-high socks and glossy red shoes with bow details.

She stands in an elegant, natural pose: her body is slightly angled (~15–20°) and not fully frontal. Her weight is shifted onto one leg, while the other leg is placed slightly forward in a gentle cross-over stance. Her posture is upright but soft with relaxed shoulders, and her head is slightly tilted toward the camera. One arm hangs relaxed by her side with a slight natural bend, while her other hand softly rests on the cake stand.
Next to her on a classic, matte white pedestal stand resting a tall, three-tier birthday cake in pink and white gradient tones, decorated with bows, hearts, stars, and multiple Hello Kitty figurines.
The cake topper shows a number “7” candle.On the front of the cake, a decorative plaque reads: “Happy Birthday” in elegant script.
The background is filled with a festive balloon arrangement in pink, white, and red, forming an arch above her.
Hanging across the backdrop is a triangular banner with Hello Kitty faces and patterns.
Warm fairy string lights glow softly behind, creating a magical bokeh effect.
Light fog or mist surrounds the lower area, adding a dreamy atmosphere.
Around the scene are multiple Hello Kitty plush toys placed on the floor and small stools, reinforcing the theme.
The floor is light wood, and the lighting is soft, warm, and diffused, enhancing the child’s face and the sparkle of her outfit.
At the floor, add a beautiful greeting card with the text: “Prompt Plum” in a decorative style.

Style & Quality Tags: ultra-detailed, photorealistic, 8k resolution, soft lighting, studio photography, shallow depth of field, bokeh, cinematic composition, highly detailed textures, vibrant colors, sharp focus, professional portrait, fantasy cute aesthetic
